rationale.complete: Round 1 done: card, impostor table and dated predictions before data; real-skeleton synthetic validation (six worlds, null sizes, mover power); replication on 4 periods and 4 natives (G38, G39, G41, G44) in two embedding models and two variants; estimates rows; confirm.py frozen with a passing dry run (not run). Missing: NE19 holdout run, read-out mechanism for movers, field measured as work.
rationale.faithfulness: The endogenous (spontaneous) part is the solid result: rooms differ beyond composition and the measured field directions in 5/7 regime-III periods, both models, with a calibrated null. The explicit-field-as-direction prediction failed, movers are mixed (1 clean adoption, 1 carry, 1 pre-aligned), and the coupling-vs-self-made-drive question is open. Scorecard A1 B1 C1 D1 E1 F1 G1 H1 I0.
rationale.usefulness: A design fact for operators: separate rooms diverge even with identical instructions, room-specific instructions double the split but not along their text, and nothing persists across goals; moved agents may keep their old project. Computable from logs with an embedding model, but no lever with a predicted effect size.

one_line: The #best/#rest content split is mostly endogenous and regenerates at each goal; room-specific instructions double it but not along their text, composition explains little, and movers split between adopting and carrying.

models.note: spontaneous room divergence yes; field direction and remanence no
rooms as domains regenerate per goal; movers mixed
named on the HH; not fitted

v2.claim: Content differences between #best and #rest are mostly not composition (f_comp 0.03–0.18) and not along the measured kickoff/operator directions; a residual split beyond random groupings appears in 5/7 regime-III periods (f_spont 0.58–0.91) and leaves no remanence across periods (all |z| < 2)
v2.scope: 8 periods (G35–G44), natives G38, G39, G41, G44; both embeddings

ladder.factor: replication across periods and both models (bge 5/8, gte 6/8)
calibrated relabel null with composition removed
penalty: "spontaneous" is a residual; unmeasured room-specific work fields land in it (fielded weeks split most, rank p 0.048)
penalty: mover test power 0.45 at ρ 0.3; movers split three ways

v2.decision: expect rooms to diverge in content on their own within a goal; reseeding rooms costs nothing across goals (no remanence)

raters.claim: In regime-III two-room periods, the #best/#rest content separation exceeds random regroupings after removing members' leave-period-out constants and the measured field directions (Q_spont > 1, p < 0.05 in 5/7 bge, 4/7 gte; f_comp small where rooms separate). Excluded: the explicit-field direction (P3 failed), the movers' room-holding (P5 mixed, 5 movers), the post hoc 'trigger' reading and fielded-vs-identical ranking.
ladder: calibrated null (real-skeleton synthetic: relabel size 0.04; Q_spont size <=0.10 under sorted composition; joint-relabel fix for remanence)
